title: CodeGrind: Visualizing UI Enhancements for a Smoother Practice Flow
summary: Showcase the latest UI refinements in CodeGrind that streamline DSA practice, from real-time editor interactions to AI-assisted guidance, with a focus on a distraction-free workflow.
core_message: CodeGrind’s UI upgrades improve problem-solving focus: faster problem load, clearer editor feedback, and integrated AI assistance that helps you learn by solving more efficiently.
cta: Try the new UI flow in CodeGrind today and share your UX feedback.
visual_brief: Static, polished UI screens showing the code editor, problem description pane, and AI chat panel with subtle cyberpunk accents; include clear callouts for live syntax highlighting and rapid problem switching.
